# DBAdminer

> A database explorer for Go. Supports PostgreSQL, MySQL, MariaDB, and SQLite. Starts read-only. Download a binary, embed it next to a `*sql.DB`, or pull the Docker image. The library module imports only the Go standard library; `cmd/dbadminer` is a separate module with drivers. License: MIT.

Prefer loopback binding. Do not expose the UI on a public network. Read-only mode is best effort — use a SELECT-only database user (and SQLite `mode=ro`) for real safety. Full access runs with the database user's privileges.

Canonical docs: https://dbadminer.github.io/
Source: https://github.com/dbadminer/dbadminer
MariaDB Ecohub: https://ecohub.mariadb.org/database-management/dbadminer

## Docs

- [Quick start](https://dbadminer.github.io/docs/): Choose binary, library embed, or Docker
- [Install](https://dbadminer.github.io/docs/install/): GitHub Releases binaries and `go run ./cmd/dbadminer`
- [Library](https://dbadminer.github.io/docs/library/): Embed `github.com/dbadminer/dbadminer` with `New` / `ListenAndServe` / `Handler`
- [CLI](https://dbadminer.github.io/docs/cli/): DSN resolution order, env vars, and field overrides
- [Docker](https://dbadminer.github.io/docs/docker/): Image usage, loopback publish, multi-database Compose
- [Configuration](https://dbadminer.github.io/docs/configuration/): Access mode, flags, and limits
- [Security](https://dbadminer.github.io/docs/security/): Host/Origin checks, read-only guarantees, reporting
- [HTTP API](https://dbadminer.github.io/docs/http-api/): Read and write JSON routes
- [Dialects](https://dbadminer.github.io/docs/dialects/): PostgreSQL, MySQL/MariaDB, SQLite, and `Dialect` extension
